_comment: Other names of storms, which local groups' pages use for them: PAGASA's local names for storms in the Philippine Area of Responsibility, by the international name the disaster feeds give ("kalmaegi": ["Tino"]). direct.ts and donate.ts read each pair both ways, only for a disaster whose title names the storm; an IFRC appeal's name such as "Typhoon Kalmaegi (Tino)" adds a pair the list lacks. Add each season's pairs as PAGASA names its storms. Names only: this list never picks a donation page.
